OptogeneticsConfig.description:
Zapit optogenetic stimulation.

The stimulation sites and ramp-down are set in the Zapit conditions file loaded in Zapit, not here; the laser
power is laser_power_mw, sent with every laser-on trial's StartStimulus (it overrides the file's power) and
logged as laserPowerMw. Bonsai reads the same file to list its conditions (stimLocations01, stimLocations02, ...).
Every trial of an optogenetics experiment sends Zapit a condition drawn at random: laser-on trials with the laser
on, all others as laser-off trials with the laser off, so galvo noise and masking light are the same on every
trial. "Stimulus" is the tone and grating; the laser is continuous: it starts at the trigger (the trigger line's
rising edge on a hardware-triggered rig), laser_to_stimulus_seconds before the first tone pip (after it if negative),
and Bonsai stops it at the trial's outcome, or after laser_max_seconds if that comes first. A trial that ends before
its trigger has no laser. Zapit is armed during the interval and adds no time. Zapit's host, port and
triggering are rig.yml's zapit block.

useZapit.description: Whether Zapit runs this experiment: every trial sends it a condition, laser on or off, and rig-control checks Zapit is answering before Go
useZapit.title: UseZapit

zapitConfigPath.description: Path to the Zapit conditions file loaded in Zapit. Its top-level stimLocations01, stimLocations02, ... entries are the conditions: numbered 1 to N with no gaps, each with an offRampDownDuration_ms of 100 to 500 ms (the masking light goes out trigger_hold_seconds after the outcome)
zapitConfigPath.title: ZapitConfigPath

laserPowerMw.description: Laser power on laser-on trials, in mW, the same for every condition: sent to Zapit with each StartStimulus (overriding the conditions file's power; Zapit's laser calibration turns it into volts) and logged as laserPowerMw (0 on laser-off trials). Required with optogenetics on
laserPowerMw.title: LaserPowerMw

laserOnProbability.description: Probability that a trial after trials_before_laser is a laser-on trial, shared equally by every condition in the Zapit conditions file, a laser-on control site included. All other trials are laser-off trials: Zapit is sent a condition with the laser off. Each trial's condition is drawn at random from all of them, laser on or off, independently of every other trial (no queue: one would make sequences predictable)
laserOnProbability.title: LaserOnProbability

laserMaxSeconds.description: Longest the laser stays on in one trial, in seconds from the trigger, timed by Bonsai; it then ramps down over the condition's offRampDownDuration_ms. A safety cap: the laser normally stops at the trial's outcome. Timed on the Harp clock, with a wall-clock backstop should the board stall. With optogenetics on it must be at least the longest stage timeLimitSeconds + laser_to_stimulus_seconds + 0.25 s (the laser runs from the first pip less laser_to_stimulus_seconds to at most the first pip plus timeLimitSeconds), so it never ends a timed-out trial's laser early; on a stage without timeLimitSeconds a longer trial loses its laser before the outcome
laserMaxSeconds.title: LaserMaxSeconds

laserToStimulusSeconds.description: Signed, in whole 50 ms beeps: the trigger comes this long before the first tone pip and grating frame (at most 0.2 s); 0 with it; negative after it. Go (beep 0, the trial's start) is the end of the interval less the lead, max(this, 0), once the stage's quiet waits hold, and the first pip comes the lead after Go in every experiment, optogenetics on or off, so timing never reveals Zapit; the trigger rises at Go with a lead, or this long after the first pip if negative. Refused above itiMinSeconds - 0.2 s (Zapit's reply margin) and further after the first pip than a stage's timeLimitSeconds (2 s on a stage without one). Licks before the first pip count for nothing (neither reward nor the wrong-lick limit)
laserToStimulusSeconds.title: LaserToStimulusSeconds

triggerHoldSeconds.description: How long the trigger line, and the masking light on it, stays high after the outcome, in seconds, on every trial of an optogenetics experiment (the line stays low without optogenetics): at least 0.5, the longest ramp-down a conditions file may have, and at most trialStructure.itiMinSeconds - laser_to_stimulus_seconds - 0.2 s, since the next trial is armed once the line falls and Zapit's reply needs 0.2 s before its trigger
triggerHoldSeconds.title: TriggerHoldSeconds

trialsBeforeLaser.description: Trials at the experiment's start with no laser-on trial among them (each still sends Zapit a condition at 0 mW). laser_on_probability applies from the next trial
trialsBeforeLaser.title: TrialsBeforeLaser

OptogeneticsConfig.title: OptogeneticsConfig

Punishment.description: What an error costs, as the lab's tasks name it (the trial log's punishSound and punishTimeoutSeconds).

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout after a punished trial, in seconds
timeoutSeconds.title: TimeoutSeconds

sound.description: The error sound on a punished trial
sound.title: Sound

Punishment.title: Punishment

PunishmentSound.description: The error sound on a punished trial: the lab's (OpenRigs.Audio), from rig.yml's errorSoundChannel alone.

enabled.description: Whether the error sound plays on a punished trial
enabled.title: Enabled

gain.description: Gain on the lab's error sound, 1 for the lab's level
gain.title: Gain

PunishmentSound.title: PunishmentSound

TrainingStage.description: One row of the training stage table: what the stage does. Rows are selected by the TrainingStage setting.

rewardFloorHz.description: Lower frequency of the reward zone, in Hz
rewardFloorHz.title: RewardFloorHz

rewardCeilingHz.description: Upper frequency of the reward zone, in Hz
rewardCeilingHz.title: RewardCeilingHz

rewardSizeUl.description: Microlitres each reward gives, at most 20 (the most one reward may ask for), on the left spout's valve, planned from the valve's calibration (calibration\valve-DO1.json). An uncalibrated valve stops the workflow at Start; the test mouse runs on one with no water (each reward logged as 0 ul)
rewardSizeUl.title: RewardSizeUl

lickToReward.description: Whether a lick in the zone earns the reward; false rewards reaching the zone, no lick needed
lickToReward.title: LickToReward

wrongLickLimit.description: Licks outside the zone that end the trial; 0: wrong licks never end it
wrongLickLimit.title: WrongLickLimit

punishWrongZone.description: Whether a trial that ends outside the reward zone is punished. A trial that runs out of time or track with the frequency in the zone is punished on every stage
punishWrongZone.title: PunishWrongZone

lickQuietSeconds.description: Quiet wait: Go needs this long with the spout released, in seconds, counted from the interval's start and restarted by every touch and release (uncapped); a held contact holds Go until released, so licks for the last reward cannot carry into the next trial; 0: off. It lengthens the interval only when the mouse licks late in it (quietWaitSeconds). Was quietSeconds, counted after the interval, until 13 Nov 2026
lickQuietSeconds.title: LickQuietSeconds

wheelQuietSeconds.description: Quiet wait: Go needs this long with the wheel still, in seconds, counted from the interval's start: the wheel's distance (forward and back added) over the last wheelQuietSeconds must stay within wheelQuietCm; 0: off (with wheelQuietCm 0)
wheelQuietSeconds.title: WheelQuietSeconds

wheelQuietCm.description: The most the wheel may move, forward and back added, within the last wheelQuietSeconds before Go, in cm; 0: off (with wheelQuietSeconds 0)
wheelQuietCm.title: WheelQuietCm

timeLimitSeconds.description: The longest a trial runs from its first tone pip, in seconds, after which it ends as a Timeout; null: no limit
timeLimitSeconds.title: TimeLimitSeconds

trackEndEndsTrial.description: Whether reaching the end of the track ends the trial
trackEndEndsTrial.title: TrackEndEndsTrial

trackLengthScale.description: The drawn track length is multiplied by this
trackLengthScale.title: TrackLengthScale

frequencyDrift.description: Whether the frequency also drifts up with time, not only with distance run
frequencyDrift.title: FrequencyDrift

truncatedTrialFraction.description: Fraction of trials whose stimulus switches off early (truncation.sweepFractions)
truncatedTrialFraction.title: TruncatedTrialFraction

TrainingStage.title: TrainingStage

itiMinSeconds.description: Lower bound of the inter-trial interval, drawn uniformly for every trial, in seconds: from the last trial's outcome (after any punishment timeout; trial 1: the first clock tick after Go) to this trial's first tone pip, with a quiet mouse. It includes the time to drink a reward (Tom Childs' fixed 2 s before his 0 or 1 s); the stage's quiet waits can only lengthen it (quietWaitSeconds)
itiMinSeconds.title: ItiMinSeconds

itiMaxSeconds.description: Upper bound of the uniformly drawn inter-trial interval, in seconds (itiMinSeconds)
itiMaxSeconds.title: ItiMaxSeconds

trackLengthsCm.description: Track lengths, one drawn per trial and scaled by the stage's trackLengthScale, in cm
trackLengthsCm.title: TrackLengthsCm

Truncation.description:
Where the stimulus switches off on a truncated trial (a stage's truncatedTrialFraction says how many).

On a truncated trial the stimulus (tone and grating) switches off part way along the sweep. Everything else about
the trial is unchanged, so it is still rewarded as normal: the animal has to keep going and find the reward
zone without the stimulus.

sweepFractions.description: Where the stimulus switches off, as a fraction of the sweep on a log scale, split evenly over truncated trials. The reward floor is at about 0.8
sweepFractions.title: SweepFractions

Truncation.title: Truncation

rngSeed.description: Seed of the random number generator for these task parameters
rngSeed.title: RngSeed

modality.description: What the trial shows: the tone sweep (auditory), the grating (visual) or both (audiovisual)
modality.title: Modality

backgroundNoiseLevel.description: Constant background white noise RMS, as a fraction of the beep RMS (0 = off)
backgroundNoiseLevel.title: BackgroundNoiseLevel

positionStepCm.description: The distance run is rounded to this before it sets the frequency, in cm
positionStepCm.title: PositionStepCm

punishment.description: The timeout and error sound a punished trial gets

truncation.description: Where the stimulus switches off on a truncated trial

trainingStages.description: Training stage table, indexed by the TrainingStage setting from 0; a setting past the end stops the workflow at Go
trainingStages.title: TrainingStages
